function.name: get_adriel_projects
function.description: Retrieve a list of projects that are associated with Adriel, including their current status and estimated completion dates. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user Adriel.

include_completed.description: A flag to determine whether to include completed projects in the list.

status_filter.description: Filter projects by status, such as 'active', 'paused', or 'completed'.

function.name: get_detail_adriel_projects
function.description: Retrieve detailed information about projects that Adriel is or has been involved in, including project status and participation role. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

project_name.description: The unique name of the project for which details are to be fetched.

include_archived.description: A flag to determine whether to include projects that are archived. Defaults to false.
